# DineQR 🍽️
> Modern, bilingual (Bengali & English) QR Code Restaurant Menu, Table-side Ordering & Real-time Kitchen Management System.

Built with lightweight vanilla JS, Tailwind CSS, and Supabase (with built-in offline/demo data mode).

---

## ✨ Features

- **📱 Customer Experience:**
  - Fast, responsive digital showcase on desktop & app-like experience on mobile.
  - Interactive table ordering via QR code (`menu.html?table=1`).
  - Item customisation (variants, addons, spice level, kitchen notes).
  - Live cooking progress & order status tracking.
  - Table waiter call notification.

- **🧑‍🍳 Kitchen & Admin Management:**
  - Live order docket with sound alerts & KOT print view.
  - Multi-status workflow (`Received` → `Cooking` → `Served` → `Paid`).
  - Table management & QR code generator.
  - Comprehensive sales reports, daily trends & category analytics.
  - Visual theme engine with custom brand colors.

---

- **Customer Showcase:** [https://qresto.asf.run/](https://qresto.asf.run/)

- **Admin Dashboard:** [https://qresto.asf.run/admin/](https://qresto.asf.run/admin/)

# Claude Switch ⚡

> **The definitive multi-account switcher and rate-limit manager for Claude.ai. Seamlessly switch accounts in one click or keyboard shortcut, track quota resets in real time, and receive desktop notifications the moment your limits expire.**

[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-1.2.1-blue.svg?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/websmartbd/Claude-Switch/releases/tag/v1.2.1)
[![Manifest V3](https://img.shields.io/badge/Manifest-V3-orange.svg?style=for-the-badge)](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/extensions/mv3/intro/)
[![License: CC BY-NC 4.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-CC_BY--NC_4.0-lightgrey.svg?style=for-the-badge)](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/)
[![Compatible with Chromium](https://img.shields.io/badge/Chromium-Chrome%20%7C%20Brave%20%7C%20Edge%20%7C%20Arc-brightgreen.svg?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/websmartbd/Claude-Switch)
[![Zero Telemetry](https://img.shields.io/badge/Telemetry-0%25%20(Local%20Only)-success.svg?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/websmartbd/Claude-Switch)

---

## 📑 Table of Contents

- [Overview](#-overview)
- [Why Claude Switch?](#-why-claude-switch)
- [Key Features](#-key-features)
- [How It Works (Under the Hood)](#-how-it-works-under-the-hood)
  - [1. Cookie Jar & Session Virtualization](#1-cookie-jar--session-virtualization)
  - [2. Cloudflare Clearance Token Preservation](#2-cloudflare-clearance-token-preservation)
  - [3. Intelligent Rate Limit Detection & Expiry Engine](#3-intelligent-rate-limit-detection--expiry-engine)
  - [4. Background Alarms & Push Notifications](#4-background-alarms--push-notifications)
  - [5. Closed Shadow DOM In-Page UI](#5-closed-shadow-dom-in-page-ui)
  - [6. High-Priority Global Shortcut Pipeline](#6-high-priority-global-shortcut-pipeline)
- [Architecture & Data Flow](#-architecture--data-flow)
- [Installation Guide](#-installation-guide)
- [How to Use](#-how-to-use)
- [Keyboard Shortcuts](#-keyboard-shortcuts)
- [Privacy & Security Audit](#-privacy--security-audit)
- [Permissions Justification](#-permissions-justification)
- [Troubleshooting & FAQ](#-troubleshooting--faq)
- [License & Attribution](#-license--attribution)
- [Disclaimer](#-disclaimer)

---

## 🌟 Overview

**Claude Switch** is an open-source, client-side productivity extension built for Chromium-based browsers (**Google Chrome, Brave, Microsoft Edge, Arc, Opera, Vivaldi**).

If you use multiple Claude accounts (personal, work, development, client-specific), logging out, checking emails for magic links, or completing Google Auth every time you hit a rate limit is tedious and disrupts your workflow. **Claude Switch** completely eliminates this friction:

- It holds your authenticated sessions simultaneously in an isolated local store.
- It switches the active Claude session by replacing the relevant Claude cookies and verifying the resulting identity.
- It displays available usage snapshots for supported paid plans and detects some Free limit messages shown in the Claude page.
- When a detected reset time is reached, your operating system can receive a native notification.

---

## 🎯 Why Claude Switch?

| Feature | Standard Browser | Claude Switch |
|---|---|---|
| **Simultaneous Accounts** | ❌ Log out & log in manually | ✅ Multiple accounts stored locally |
| **Switch Duration** | Manual sign-in flow | Depends on cookie restore and Claude verification |
| **Keyboard Switching** | ❌ None | ✅ `Ctrl + Shift + 1` .. `9` anywhere |
| **Rate Limit Awareness** | ❌ Trial and error | ✅ Usage snapshots + detected Free reset countdown |
| **Reset Notifications** | ❌ None | ✅ Scheduled desktop reminder after a detected reset time |
| **Privacy & Storage** | Varies | Local Chrome profile storage; communicates with Claude first-party endpoints |

---

## ✨ Key Features

- 🔄 **One-Click Account Switching:** Request a switch from the in-page control or toolbar popup; the extension verifies the target account before reporting success.
- ⚡ **Global Shortcuts (`Ctrl + Shift + 1..9`):** Switch profiles immediately from anywhere on `claude.ai`, even while typing inside the prompt box.
- ⏱️ **Detected Free Limit Countdown:** Automatically parses Claude's rate limit notices (*"You are out of free messages until 5:20 PM"*) and computes a dynamic percentage bar and remaining time (`100% · in 1h 45m`).
- 🔔 **Instant Desktop Notifications:** Receive a desktop notification when an account reaches its scheduled reset time:
  > *"Your (Nickname) (Plan) claude account limit has been reset"*  
  Clicking a reset notification first requests a switch to the associated saved account; a new chat tab opens only if the switch succeeds.
- 📊 **Pro & Max Quotas:** Displays 5-hour rolling session and 7-day weekly utilization metrics for paid tiers.
- 🎨 **Visual Status Avatars:**
  - 🟢 **Normal / Ready:** Account is ready to chat.
  - 🟡 **Warning:** Usage ≥ 70%.
  - 🔴 **Critical:** Account limit reached (100%), showing exact reset countdown.
- 🪟 **Minimalist In-Page Floating Avatar:** Seamlessly positioned right beside Claude's sidebar footer buttons (`.df-footer-aux`), blending invisibly into Claude's native design system.
- 🛡️ **Zero Telemetry & 100% Local:** No analytics, no remote database, no tracking scripts. All data remains in your browser's `chrome.storage.local`.

---

## 🔬 How It Works (Under the Hood)

Claude Switch achieves seamless switching through a combination of low-level Chrome extension APIs and client-side DOM intelligence.

### 1. Cookie Jar & Session Virtualization
Claude.ai authenticates requests using HTTP-only session cookies (`sessionKey`, `lastActiveOrg`).
- When you add an account, the background service worker takes a snapshot of Claude's active cookies using `chrome.cookies.getAll()`.
- The snapshot is stored in the extension's `chrome.storage.local`. **By default this is NOT encrypted**; anyone or any software with access to the same browser profile may be able to read these session credentials. Since 1.2.0 you can turn on **passphrase protection** (Manage → Turn on protection): each account's cookies are then encrypted with AES-256-GCM (key derived from your passphrase with PBKDF2-SHA256, 600,000 iterations). The unlocked key is kept only in `chrome.storage.session` (browser memory) and is discarded when you click Lock or close the browser. If you forget the passphrase, saved sessions cannot be recovered; you sign in again.
- When switching from Account A to Account B:
  1. The extension snapshots and saves Account A's current session tokens.
  2. It cleans Claude's session cookies.
  3. It injects Account B's stored cookies using `chrome.cookies.set()`.
  4. It queries `/api/bootstrap` to verify identity and update organization UUIDs.
  5. It reloads active Claude tabs directly to `https://claude.ai/new` to prevent 404 conversation errors.

### 2. Cloudflare Clearance Token Preservation
Claude runs behind Cloudflare bot protection (`__cf_bm`, `cf_clearance`, `_cfuvid`). 
If an extension clears all cookies blindly, Cloudflare will trigger a CAPTCHA challenge on every single switch!
**Claude Switch solves this:** The internal `PRESERVED_COOKIES` whitelist leaves Cloudflare clearance tokens untouched during cookie swapping, ensuring you never face unnecessary CAPTCHA puzzles when toggling accounts.

### 3. Intelligent Rate Limit Detection & Expiry Engine
Claude's official `/usage` endpoint may not expose the Free-account message window in the same form as paid-plan usage. Claude Switch attempts to detect supported rate-limit text in the page DOM; this is best-effort and can break when Claude changes its UI:
- A `MutationObserver` continuously scans page banners and alert containers for strings matching:  
  `out of (?:free )?messages until ([0-9]{1,2}:[0-9]{2}(?: AM|PM)?)`
- When detected, the text (e.g. `5:20 PM`) is parsed into an absolute UNIX timestamp (`resetsAt`).
- **Intelligent Tomorrow-Aware Guard:** Claude free limits operate on dynamic rolling windows. If a banner states "tomorrow", the engine reliably calculates next-day timestamps up to 24 hours. Past timestamps without an explicit "tomorrow" indicator are treated as immediately expired, eliminating false future limits and phantom alarms.
- The state is persisted in `cas:freeLimits` so countdowns remain accurate even when switching to other accounts.

### 4. Background Alarms & Push Notifications
- When an account limit is detected, a persistent alarm is scheduled with `chrome.alarms.create("reset:" + accountId, { when: resetsAt })`.
- Even if your browser is minimized or you are browsing other websites, the service worker wakes up at the exact timestamp.
- It verifies the reset, purges the rate-limit flag from storage, and dispatches a native desktop notification via `chrome.notifications.create()`.
- Clicking the notification automatically opens `https://claude.ai/new` on that account.

### 5. Closed Shadow DOM In-Page UI
To guarantee zero CSS contamination:
- The in-page switcher mounts into an isolated **closed** Shadow Root (`mode: "closed"`).
- Claude's complex Tailwind and React stylesheets cannot alter or break the extension's UI, and the extension's CSS cannot bleed into Claude's layout.
- The floating avatar dynamically anchors to Claude's sidebar footer (`.df-footer-aux`), adjusting its placement automatically across viewport resizes and SPA navigations.

### 6. High-Priority Global Shortcut Pipeline
- The keyboard listener attaches to `window` in the **capture phase** (`true`).
- It bypasses default input-focus blocks, meaning `Ctrl + Shift + 1..9` executes even when your cursor is blinking inside Claude's message prompt box.
- It normalizes keycodes across standard number rows, Numpad keys, and shifted character symbols (`!`, `@`, `#`...) across international keyboard layouts.

---

## 🏗️ Architecture & Data Flow

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor User as User
    participant Page as Claude Webpage (DOM)
    participant CS as Content Script (Shadow DOM)
    participant BG as Background Service Worker
    participant Store as chrome.storage.local
    participant Ck as chrome.cookies API
    participant API as Claude.ai Backend

    User->>CS: Press Ctrl+Shift+2 (or Click Avatar)
    CS->>BG: chrome.runtime.sendMessage({ type: "switch", accountId })
    BG->>Store: Snapshot current active account cookies
    BG->>Ck: Clear sessionKey & lastActiveOrg (Preserve Cloudflare)
    BG->>Ck: Restore Target Account Cookies
    BG->>API: GET /api/bootstrap (Verify Account Identity)
    BG->>Store: Update activeId & persist fresh cookies
    BG->>Page: Navigate tab to https://claude.ai/new
    BG->>CS: Broadcast updated state
    CS->>User: Render active avatar & updated quotas
```

---

## 📥 Installation Guide

### Option 1: Load as Unpacked Extension (Recommended)

1. **Download:**
   - Clone this repository or download the source code as a `.zip` file from the [Releases](https://github.com/) page.
   - Extract the `.zip` archive into a folder (e.g. `Documents/Claude-Switcher`).

2. **Open Extensions Page:**
   - **Google Chrome:** Visit `chrome://extensions`
   - **Brave Browser:** Visit `brave://extensions`
   - **Microsoft Edge:** Visit `edge://extensions`
   - **Arc Browser:** Visit `arc://extensions`

3. **Enable Developer Mode:**
   - Toggle on the **"Developer mode"** switch located in the top-right corner.

4. **Load the Extension:**
   - Click the **"Load unpacked"** button in the top-left toolbar.
   - Select the `Claude-Switcher` folder containing `manifest.json`.
   - The extension will appear instantly with the **Claude Switch** icon!

5. **Pin to Toolbar (Optional):**
   - Click the puzzle icon in your browser toolbar and pin **Claude Switch** for quick access.

---

## 💡 How to Use

### Adding Accounts
1. Sign in to your first Claude account on [claude.ai](https://claude.ai).
2. Click the floating avatar icon at the bottom of the sidebar (or open the toolbar popup).
3. Click **"+ Add another account"**.
4. The extension will safely store your current account, clear session cookies, and open a login tab.
5. Sign in to your second account with Google or email magic link.
6. The extension automatically detects authentication, captures the session, and registers the new profile!
7. Repeat for as many accounts as you need.

### Switching Accounts
- **Method 1:** Press **`Ctrl + Shift + 1`**, **`Ctrl + Shift + 2`** ... **`Ctrl + Shift + 9`** anywhere on Claude.
- **Method 2:** Click the small circular avatar in the sidebar footer to open the quick-switcher menu, then click any account.
- **Method 3:** Click the extension icon in your browser toolbar to switch from the popup.

---

## ⌨️ Keyboard Shortcuts

| Shortcut | Description | Context |
|---|---|---|
| `Ctrl + Shift + 1` | Switch instantly to Account #1 | Anywhere on `claude.ai` |
| `Ctrl + Shift + 2` | Switch instantly to Account #2 | Anywhere on `claude.ai` |
| `Ctrl + Shift + 3..9` | Switch instantly to Accounts #3 through #9 | Anywhere on `claude.ai` |
| `Click on Avatar` | Toggle in-page account switcher dropdown | Sidebar footer |
| `Escape` | Dismiss / close the open switcher dropdown | When dropdown is open |

> **Note:** Shortcuts are designed with non-conflicting modifier keys (`Ctrl + Shift`), ensuring they never trigger browser tab switching (`Alt + 1..9`).

---

## 🔒 Privacy & Security Audit

Authentication tokens grant access to your private AI conversations. Claude Switch is architected around a strict zero-trust local model:

- ❌ **No Analytics / Telemetry:** No Google Analytics, no Mixpanel, no Sentry, no remote beacons.
- ❌ **No External Servers:** The extension does not own, manage, or contact any backend server.
- 🌐 **Direct First-Party Connections Only:** Network requests (`fetch`) communicate solely with `https://claude.ai/*`.
- 🗄️ **Local Profile Storage & LevelDB Compaction:** Authentication cookies, labels, and rate-limit metadata are stored in `chrome.storage.local`. Optional AES-256-GCM passphrase encryption can be enabled in Manage. Note that on Chromium, previous unencrypted storage logs in LevelDB may persist on disk until Chromium's internal LevelDB compaction cycle completes. Even then, malware running as you while the vault is unlocked can still reach the key in memory; treat the browser profile as sensitive.
- 👁️ **Source Available for Inspection:** The JavaScript extension files are included in this repository. The distributed files are bundled JavaScript; original TypeScript source maps and a complete TypeScript source tree are not included.

---

## 🔑 Permissions Justification

In accordance with Chrome Web Store Developer Policies:

| Permission | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `cookies` | Required to read, snapshot, and restore session authentication tokens strictly for `claude.ai` domains. |
| `storage` | Used to persist account identifiers, labels, colors, and rate-limit reset timestamps locally. |
| `alarms` | Used to schedule background wakeups to check rate-limit expiration and update badge counts. |
| `notifications` | Used to deliver native desktop push notifications when an account limit resets. |
| `webRequest` (optional) | Not granted at install. Requested only if you turn on the "Wrong-account helper" in Manage; it watches 403/404 responses from `claude.ai/api/*` to suggest the right account. Turn the toggle off to revoke it. |
| `host: https://claude.ai/*` | Restricts extension code injection and cookie manipulation exclusively to Claude's official domain. |

---

## ❓ Troubleshooting & FAQ

#### Q: Why didn't the rate-limit countdown appear immediately?
**A:** Claude displays rate limits only after a message is rejected by the server (e.g. *"You are out of free messages until..."*). Once that banner appears, Claude Switch immediately parses the time, generates the countdown bar, and schedules your reset notification.

#### Q: Do I need to re-login every time I restart my computer?
**A:** No. Your session cookies remain safely preserved in `chrome.storage.local`. Unless you manually click "Sign Out" inside Claude, your sessions persist across browser restarts.

#### Q: Why do we use `Ctrl + Shift + Number` instead of `Alt + Number`?
**A:** In Chrome and Brave on Linux and Windows, `Alt + 1..9` and `Ctrl + 1..9` are reserved browser accelerators that switch tabs. `Ctrl + Shift + Number` provides universal compatibility without conflicting with browser navigation.

#### Q: What happens if an account session expires?
**A:** If a session token expires naturally on Claude's servers, the extension marks that account with a red label (`signed out — sign in again`). Clicking it opens the login flow to refresh that account's session.

## 1.2.1 patch release

- **Rate limit detection accuracy:** `parseTimeToday` strictly validates whether Claude specified "tomorrow"; expired limits during the same day are correctly marked as elapsed instead of rolling over to tomorrow.
- **Chat false-positive prevention:** `extractResetTime` strictly checks for explicit limit phrases (`out of messages`, `usage limit`, etc.) before matching time patterns, preventing normal conversations containing times from falsely triggering limit states.
- **Passphrase recovery:** Added emergency session erase option ("Forgot passphrase? Erase sessions") when vault is locked and passphrase is lost.
- **Passphrase confirmation:** Added confirm passphrase input field during vault setup to prevent accidental lockout from typos.
- **Concurrency fix in popup:** Switched free-limit manual clearing in popup from direct storage overwrites to the background message queue (`freeLimit:clear`).
- **Window focus:** Clicking desktop reset notifications now brings the browser window to the foreground (`chrome.windows.update` with `focused: true`).

## 1.2.0 security update

- **Optional passphrase protection** for saved sessions (AES-256-GCM, PBKDF2-SHA256 600k iterations). Locked state blocks switching, never writes cookies in the clear, and keeps ciphertext intact while you rename/reorder accounts. Turn it off any time with your passphrase.
- **`webRequest` is now an optional permission**, requested only when you enable the Wrong-account helper. Fresh installs no longer carry that permission warning.
- **Untrusted-input hardening:** `freeLimit:set` (sent from the claude.ai page) now requires a known account, a sane reset time, and stores only whitelisted, length-capped fields.
- **Compatibility signals:** a clear error when Claude's identity API changes shape, and a popup notice when a paid account's usage endpoint can no longer be read. The in-page pill already falls back to other anchors / a floating position if Claude's sidebar markup changes.
- Note: these changes were made directly in the shipped JavaScript. If you maintain the original TypeScript sources, port them back or the next build will drop them.

## 1.1.1 maintenance update

- Persists cookie `storeId` and `partitionKey` metadata when the browser exposes them, so restoration receives the same context.
- Refreshes account identity, plan, and organization metadata after a successful session verification.
- Reset notification clicks cancel an in-progress add-account flow before switching to the notification account; an existing `/new` tab is reused instead of opening a duplicate.
- Rejects invalid clock values, removes the broad `body.innerText` fallback, and ignores synthetic clicks/keyboard events in the in-page controls.
- Serializes free-limit writes through the background worker to prevent multi-tab cache overwrites, persists notification state, and clears stale reset alarms.
- Caps the popup height at 590px.
- Security note (1.1.1): cookies were stored unencrypted. Encryption is available as an opt-in feature from 1.2.0.

## Testing notes

The release package is checked for JavaScript syntax, valid Manifest V3 JSON, referenced local assets, and ZIP integrity. Live authentication, account switching, Claude usage endpoints, and browser notification behavior require manual testing in a signed-in Chrome profile; they cannot be truthfully certified by static checks alone.

readme:
# Clip Manager

A lightweight clipboard history manager for Linux (GNOME / Ubuntu), built with Python and GTK3.

Press **Super+V** to pop up your recent clipboard history, search through it, pin items you want to keep, and copy anything back to the clipboard with one click — the same Windows-style "clipboard history" experience, on Linux.

## Backstory

I switched from Windows to Linux, and one of the things I used constantly on Windows was the built-in clipboard history (Win+V) — copy a few things, then pick whichever one you need later instead of re-copying over and over.

On Linux, I tried several existing clipboard manager extensions and apps looking for the same thing, but none of them really felt right — some were clunky, some didn't handle images well, some didn't integrate cleanly with GNOME, some just didn't feel reliable. So I ended up building my own, exactly the way I wanted it to work.

Once it was working well for me, it didn't make sense to keep it just for myself. If you also moved to Linux from Windows and miss this one specific feature, this is for you.

## How it works

Clip Manager runs as a small background daemon plus a GTK3 popup window:

- A **daemon process** (`clip-manager.py run`) watches the system clipboard and saves new text/image content into a local SQLite database (`~/.local/share/clip-manager/history.db`), with content hashing so the same item is never saved twice in a row.
- Pressing **Super+V** runs `clip-manager.py show`, which talks to the daemon over a local Unix socket and tells it to pop up the history window — if the daemon isn't running yet, it gets started automatically.
- The popup is a borderless GTK window you can **drag to reposition**, search, filter by type, pin/unpin, delete, or clear from.
- **The Wayland problem:** GNOME's Wayland compositor (Mutter) deliberately blocks a background app with no focused window from reading the clipboard — this is intentional upstream behavior, not a bug. To get reliable background capture anyway, this project ships a small **GNOME Shell extension** that runs inside gnome-shell's own process (which *is* allowed to read the clipboard) and forwards new clipboard content to the daemon over the same local socket. This is what lets copy/cut be captured instantly, even on Wayland.
- Everything is local — no network access, no telemetry. Data stays in `~/.local/share/clip-manager/` and `~/.cache/clip-manager/`.

## Features

- Clipboard history for both **text and images**
- **Super+V** global keyboard shortcut to open the popup
- **Search** and filter by type (All / Text / Images)
- **Pin** important items so they're never auto-trimmed or cleared
- **Clear history** with one click — pinned items are always kept
- Items can only be deleted after being unpinned, so pinned content is never lost by accident
- Runs automatically in the background and **starts on login**
- Works on both **X11 and Wayland** (a small GNOME Shell extension is included to work around a Wayland clipboard-access restriction for background apps — see "How it works" above)
- Automatic de-duplication — copying the same content twice won't create duplicate entries
- Drag-to-move popup window, with a clean, non-intrusive UI (no dark mode, by design)

## Requirements

- Ubuntu / GNOME Shell (tested on Ubuntu 26.04, GNOME Shell 50.1)
- Python 3 with PyGObject (GTK3) — these are already installed on most GNOME/Ubuntu systems
- `gsettings` and `gnome-extensions` command-line tools (included by default on GNOME)

## Installation

1. Download and extract this bundle.
2. Open a terminal in the extracted folder.
3. Run the setup script (as your normal user — **do not** use `sudo`):

   ```bash
   chmod +x run.sh
   ./run.sh
   ```

4. Choose **1) Install** from the menu.

You can also skip the menu and run a step directly:

```bash
./run.sh install
./run.sh uninstall
```

### What installation does

| Step | What happens |
|---|---|
| 1 | Copies `clip-manager.py` to `~/.local/bin/clip-manager.py` |
| 2 | Creates an autostart entry so the clipboard daemon runs automatically on login |
| 3 | Installs and enables the companion GNOME Shell extension (needed for reliable clipboard capture on Wayland) |
| 4 | Sets up the **Super+V** keyboard shortcut — it checks for conflicts first and will never silently override an existing shortcut on the same key |
| 5 | Restarts the clipboard daemon so everything is live immediately |

> **First-time extension install:** if the GNOME Shell extension has never been installed before, GNOME requires a logout/login (or a full restart) before it becomes active. The installer will tell you if this is needed.

## Usage

- **Super+V** — open the clipboard history popup
- Type in the search box to filter history
- Click a row to copy it back to the clipboard
- Click the star icon to **pin** an item (pinned items stay at the top and are protected from clearing/trimming)
- Click the trash icon to delete an item (an item must be unpinned first)
- Click the broom icon to **clear all history** — pinned items are always kept
- **Esc** closes the popup
- Drag the popup's title bar to move it anywhere on screen

## Uninstallation

```bash
./run.sh uninstall
```

This removes:
- The installed script
- The autostart entry
- The GNOME Shell extension
- Only the keyboard shortcut entry that points to Clip Manager (any other custom shortcuts you have are left untouched)

Your clipboard history database is **not** deleted automatically. To remove it as well:

```bash
rm -rf ~/.local/share/clip-manager ~/.cache/clip-manager
```

## File locations

| Path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `~/.local/bin/clip-manager.py` | The installed application |
| `~/.config/autostart/clip-manager.desktop` | Autostart entry |
| `~/.local/share/gnome-shell/extensions/clip-manager-watcher@websmartbd.local/` | GNOME Shell extension |
| `~/.local/share/clip-manager/history.db` | Clipboard history database |
| `~/.cache/clip-manager/` | Runtime socket, PID file, and logs |

## Troubleshooting

- **Super+V doesn't open the popup:** check for a conflicting shortcut in *Settings → Keyboard → Keyboard Shortcuts*. The installer only adds the shortcut automatically if that key combination is free.
- **Popup doesn't show after installing the extension for the first time:** log out and back in once (or restart), then try again.
- **Copy/cut isn't appearing in history:** confirm the GNOME Shell extension is enabled:

  ```bash
  gnome-extensions show clip-manager-watcher@websmartbd.local
  ```

  It should report `State: ENABLED`. If it says `OUT OF DATE`, your GNOME Shell version may need to be added to the extension's `shell-version` list in `extension/metadata.json`.
- **Something isn't working after an update:** restart the daemon manually:

  ```bash
  python3 ~/.local/bin/clip-manager.py restart
  ```

- Logs are at `~/.cache/clip-manager/daemon.log`.

## License

Personal project — use and modify freely.

# Authia - Enterprise PHP Licensing Framework


**Authia** is a lightweight, high-performance, and ultra-secure licensing framework for PHP developers. It provides a complete solution for managing, generating, and validating software licenses with an emphasis on modern security standards and developer experience.

## 🚀 Vision
Protect your intellectual property without the bloat. Authia offers a "Set it and Forget it" approach to licensing, allowing you to integrate license validation into your PHP applications in minutes.

---

## ✨ Key Features

### 🛡️ Hardened Security
- **Argon2id Hashing:** Uses industry-standard cryptography to protect API keys.
- **CSRF Protection:** Secure form submissions across the entire dashboard.
- **Rate Limiting:** Built-in protection against brute-force attacks and license spamming.
- **Secure Sessions:** HttpOnly and SameSite cookie policies to prevent session hijacking.
- **Anti-Enumeration:** Masked error messages to prevent hackers from identifying registered domains.

### ⚡ Developer Experience
- **One-Click Generation:** Sleek AJAX-powered portal for generating and recovering keys.
- **Developer API:** A clean JSON endpoint for remote license validation.
- **Mobile Responsive:** A high-density, professional dashboard that works on any device.
- **Easy Integration:** Simple cURL-based validation that can be dropped into any project.

### 📊 Admin Control
- **Domain Management:** Activate, deactivate, or delete licenses with a single click.
- **SMTP Integration:** Automated email notifications for configuration and recovery.
- **Detailed Analytics:** Monitor total, active, and expired domains at a glance.

---

## 🛠️ Tech Stack
- **Backend:** PHP 8.1+ (Procedural & OOP Mix)
- **Database:** MariaDB / MySQL
- **CSS:** Tailwind CSS (Modern, high-density layout)
- **Icons:** Font Awesome 6
- **Typography:** Inter & JetBrains Mono

---

## � Requirements
- **PHP:** 8.1 or higher
- **Database:** MySQL 5.7+ or MariaDB 10.3+
- **Extensions:** `mysqli`, `openssl`, `json`, `session`, `hash`
- **Web Server:** Apache (with `mod_rewrite` recommended) or Nginx

## �📥 Installation

Authia features a built-in **3-Step GUI Installer** to get you up and running in minutes.

1. **Clone the Repository:**
   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/websmartbd/Authentication-Manager.git
   ```

2. **Upload & Permissions:**
   - Upload all files to your server's root or a subdirectory.
   - Ensure the `config/` directory is writable by the web server.

3. **Run the GUI Installer:**
   Navigate to `install.php` (e.g., `https://your-site.com/install.php`) and follow the professional setup wizard:
   - **Step 0: API Verification:** Enter your master API key to authorize the installation. Get your feww key from [authia.hs.vc](https://authia.hs.vc/).
   - **Step 1: Database Configuration:** Provide your MySQL/MariaDB credentials. Authia will automatically create the configuration file and import the necessary database schema.
   - **Step 2: Admin Setup:** Create your secure administrator account. Authia uses **Argon2id** hashing for maximum password security.

4. **Post-Installation:**
   > ⚠️ **CRITICAL SECURITY STEP:** Delete the `install.php` file from your server immediately after successful installation to prevent unauthorized access to your configuration.

---

Perform a POST request to your validation endpoint:

**Endpoint:** `https://your-domain.com/api`

# DevPack **Easy PHP Hosting with Subdomains & MySQL — All from your browser.** [![PHP](https://img.shields.io/badge/PHP-8.0%2B-777BB4?style=flat-square&logo=php&logoColor=white)](https://php.net) [![Apache](https://img.shields.io/badge/Apache-2.4%2B-D22128?style=flat-square&logo=apache&logoColor=white)](https://httpd.apache.org) [![MySQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/MySQL-5.7%2B-4479A1?style=flat-square&logo=mysql&logoColor=white)](https://mysql.com) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-22C55E?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) [![Issues](https://img.shields.io/github/issues/websmartbd/devpack?style=flat-square&color=EF4444)](https://github.com/websmartbd/devpack/issues) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/websmartbd/devpack?style=flat-square&color=F59E0B)](https://github.com/websmartbd/devpack/stargazers) [🚀 Features](#-features) • [📦 Installation](#-installation) • [⚙️ Configuration](#%EF%B8%8F-configuration) • [🖥️ Usage](#%EF%B8%8F-usage) • [🔒 Security](#-security) • [🤝 Contributing](#-contributing) • [🐛 Bug Report](#-bug-report) ---
## 🌟 What is DevPack? DevPack is a **self-hosted PHP hosting control panel** that allows you to easily: - ✅ Create and manage custom **subdomains** - ✅ Provision **MySQL databases** with a single click - ✅ Upload and edit code directly from your browser using the **file manager** - ✅ Monitor all your sites via a live **dashboard** - ✅ Run perfectly on **Shared hosting (cPanel)**, **VPS**, or **Localhost** > 💡 The easiest way to deploy PHP sites on your own server without needing deep technical knowledge. --- ## 🚀 Features ### 🌐 Subdomain Management - Create a new subdomain simply by filling out a form - Each subdomain resides in its own isolated directory - Delete subdomains anytime with one click ### 🗄️ MySQL Database - Provision dedicated databases for your subdomains - Auto-generated database usernames and passwords - Credentials securely stored in the `data/` folder - Supports both cPanel API and VPS direct MySQL connections ### 📁 File Manager - **Upload** — Drag & drop file uploading - **Edit** — Built-in browser-based code editor - **Manage** — Rename, Move, Delete, and create directories - **Download** — Download any file instantly ### 📊 Live Dashboard - Total subdomains count - Total files deployed - Storage used (Auto-formats to KB/MB/GB) - Per-site file and folder listing ### 🛡️ Security - CSRF protection across all forms - Rate limiting for login attempts - Session hardening (httpOnly, SameSite, Secure) - Security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, etc.) - Dangerous PHP functions automatically disabled - Sensitive directories protected via `.htaccess` ### ⚡ Server Support | Type | Description | |------|-------------| | `local` | XAMPP / Laragon / WAMP / localhost | | `cpanel` | Shared hosting with cPanel API | | `vps` | Bare VPS / dedicated server | --- ## 📦 Installation ### Requirements - PHP **8.0+** - Apache with **mod_rewrite** enabled - MySQL / MariaDB **5.7+** - `AllowOverride All` enabled in your Apache configuration ### Step 1 — Clone the repository ```bash git clone https://github.com/websmartbd/devpack.git cd devpack ``` ### Step 2 — Configure Edit the `config/config.php` file with your details: ```php // MySQL connection define('DB_HOST', 'localhost'); define('DB_USER', 'root'); define('DB_PASS', ''); // Panel login define('PANEL_PASS', 'your_secure_password_here'); // Hosting details define('SERVER_TYPE', 'local'); // 'local', 'cpanel', or 'vps' define('MAIN_DOMAIN', 'localhost'); // Your main domain name ``` ### Step 3 — Secure Directory Permissions Ensure that the `data/` and `sites/` directories are writable by the web server: ```bash chmod -R 775 data sites chown -R www-data:www-data data sites ``` *(On cPanel/Shared hosting, standard 755 permissions usually work fine).* ### Step 4 — Apache Virtual Host ```apache ServerName yourdomain.com ServerAlias *.yourdomain.com DocumentRoot /path/to/devpack DirectoryIndex index.php AllowOverride All Require all granted ``` ### Step 5 — Done! 🎉 Open `http://yourdomain.com` in your browser and log into the Control Panel! --- ## ⚙️ Configuration ### `config/config.php` — Core Settings | Constant | Description | Default | |----------|-------------|---------| | `DB_HOST` | MySQL host | `localhost` | | `DB_USER` | MySQL root/admin username | — | | `DB_PASS` | MySQL password | — | | `DB_PORT` | MySQL port | `3306` | | `PANEL_PASS` | Control panel login password | — | | `MAIN_DOMAIN` | Your main domain | `localhost` | | `SERVER_TYPE` | Hosting type | `local` | | `SITES_ROOT` | Path where sites are stored | `./sites` | | `DATA_DIR` | Path for credentials & logs | `./data` | | `DB_PREFIX_SEP` | DB name separator | `_` | ### Server Types **`local`** — XAMPP/Laragon/WAMP: ```php define('SERVER_TYPE', 'local'); define('MAIN_DOMAIN', 'localhost'); ``` **`cpanel`** — Shared hosting: ```php define('SERVER_TYPE', 'cpanel'); define('MAIN_DOMAIN', 'yourdomain.com'); // cPanel API credentials also needed in config ``` **`vps`** — Bare VPS: ```php define('SERVER_TYPE', 'vps'); define('MAIN_DOMAIN', 'yourdomain.com'); ``` --- ## 🖥️ Usage ### Control Panel 1. Visit `https://yourdomain.com/` (or wherever DevPack is hosted) 2. Log in using your `PANEL_PASS` 3. Manage everything directly from the Dashboard ### Steps to Deploy a New Site ```text 1. Click "Create Subdomain" → Enter subdomain name (e.g., myapp) → myapp.yourdomain.com is instantly created! 2. Go to "File Manager" → Upload or edit your code directly in the browser. 3. (Optional) Click "Create Database" → Provision a MySQL DB. → Credentials will automatically be saved and displayed. 4. Done! myapp.yourdomain.com is now live! ``` ### File Structure ```text devpack/ ├── index.html # Landing page (static HTML) ├── index.php # Login page + Main router ├── control-panel.php # Admin dashboard ├── file-manager.php # File manager functionality ├── sqldb.php # Database manager functionality ├── .htaccess # Apache rules & security │ ├── config/ │ ├── config.php # ⚙️ Main configuration │ ├── router.php # Subdomain routing logic │ ├── security.php # Security helpers (CSRF, rate limit) │ ├── api.php # Internal API handlers │ └── monitor.php # System monitoring │ ├── sites/ # 📁 All subdomain files stored here │ └── myapp/ # → myapp.yourdomain.com │ └── index.php │ └── data/ # 🔒 Sensitive data (not web-accessible) ├── .credentials/ # DB credentials per subdomain └── .rate_limits.json # Login rate limit data ``` --- ## 🔒 Security DevPack takes security seriously: | Feature | Details | |---------|---------| | **CSRF Protection** | Token validation on all POST requests | | **Rate Limiting** | 5 login attempts per 5 minutes (configurable) | | **Session Security** | httpOnly, SameSite=Strict, Secure cookies | | **HSTS** | Enforces HTTPS in production (31536000s) | | **CSP** | Strict Content-Security-Policy headers | | **X-Frame-Options** | Protects against Clickjacking | | **Directory Protection** | `data/` and `config/` are blocked via `.htaccess` | | **PHP Hardening** | Dangerous functions like `exec`, `shell_exec` are disabled | > ⚠️ **Important:** In production, ensure `PANEL_PASS` is strong and set the `config/config.php` file permissions to `644`. --- ## 🤝 Contributing DevPack is an open-source project. Contributions are highly appreciated! ### How to Contribute ```bash # 1. Fork the repo on GitHub # 2. Clone your fork locally git clone https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/devpack.git cd devpack # 3. Create a new branch git checkout -b feature/your-feature-name # Or for a bug fix: git checkout -b fix/issue-description # 4. Make your changes and commit git add . git commit -m "feat: add your feature description" # 5. Push to your fork git push origin feature/your-feature-name # 6. Open a Pull Request on the main repository! ``` ### Commit Message Format ```text feat: Added a new feature fix: Fixed a bug docs: Updated documentation style: Code formatting (no logic changes) refactor: Code restructuring test: Added or updated tests chore: Build processes, configuration updates ``` ### Contribution Ideas - [ ] Nginx support - [ ] PHP version selector per subdomain - [ ] Automatic SSL via Let's Encrypt - [ ] Backup & restore functionality - [ ] Two-factor authentication - [ ] Site-level analytics - [ ] Docker support - [ ] Multi-admin user system - [ ] Email notification system - [ ] Subdomain traffic monitoring ### Code Guidelines - Ensure compatibility with PHP 8.0+ - Always perform input validation on security-sensitive functions - Update the README if adding new features - Both English and Bengali comments are acceptable in the codebase --- ## 🐛 Bug Report If you discover a bug or run into issues, please report it via **[GitHub Issues](https://github.com/websmartbd/devpack/issues)**. ### Before Reporting a Bug 1. Search existing issues to avoid duplicates. 2. Check if you are using the latest version. 3. Verify your `config/config.php` settings. ### What to Include in Your Bug Report ```markdown **Bug Description:** [Clearly describe what the issue is] **Steps to Reproduce:** 1. I did this... 2. Then I did this... 3. The error occurred **Expected Behavior:** [What you expected to happen] **Actual Behavior:** [What actually happened] **Environment:** - OS: [e.g., Ubuntu 22.04] - PHP: [e.g., 8.2] - Apache: [e.g., 2.4.54] - MySQL: [e.g., 8.0] - SERVER_TYPE: [local/cpanel/vps] - Browser: [e.g., Chrome 120] **Error Log (if any):** [Paste the content of data/.error_log if applicable] ``` **[🐛 Report a Bug](https://github.com/websmartbd/devpack/issues/new?labels=bug&template=bug_report.md)**    **[💡 Request a Feature](https://github.com/websmartbd/devpack/issues/new?labels=enhancement&template=feature_request.md)** --- ## 📄 License This project is licensed under the [MIT License](LICENSE). ```text MIT License — You are free to use, modify, and distribute this software. Attribution is appreciated but not required. ``` --- ## 🙏 Acknowledgements - [Tailwind CSS](https://tailwindcss.com) — UI styling - [Remix Icon](https://remixicon.com) — Icons - [JetBrains Mono](https://www.jetbrains.com/lp/mono/) — Monospace font - [Inter](https://rsms.me/inter/) & [Plus Jakarta Sans](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Plus+Jakarta+Sans) — Typography ---

# 🎙️ VoxGen | Premium Voice AI Studio VoxGen is a high-performance, privacy-focused Text-to-Speech (TTS) application built to leverage the cutting-edge **Cartesia AI** platform. It provides a studio-grade experience for generating high-quality AI speech with near-zero latency. ![VoxGen Banner](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1550751827-4bd374c3f58b?auto=format&fit=crop&q=80&w=1200&h=300) ## ✨ Features - **🚀 Low-Latency Streaming:** Uses chunked transfer encoding to start playback almost instantly as audio bytes arrive from the Cartesia API. - **🎭 Sonic-3 Engine Support:** Optimized for the latest high-fidelity voice models. - **🔒 Privacy First:** API keys are never stored on any server. Sensitive credentials stay in your browser's `localStorage` and are only used to authenticate your requests to the Cartesia API via a local proxy. - **🛡️ Transparent & Open Source:** We believe in absolute transparency. All code is open-source so you can verify exactly how your data and tokens are handled. - **🎨 Premium UI:** sleek dark-mode design built with **Tailwind CSS** and **Phosphor Icons**. - **🎧 Custom Audio Player:** Control playback, adjust volume, and download generated audio seamlessly. - **📱 Responsive Design:** Fully optimized for mobile, tablet, and desktop workflows. - **⌨️ Power User Tools:** Keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+Enter) and real-time character counters. ## 🛠️ Tech Stack - **Backend:** Node.js, Express.js - **Frontend:** HTML5, Vanilla JavaScript, Tailwind CSS - **API Proxy:** Direct Cartesia AI integration with streaming support - **Icons:** Phosphor Icons - **Typography:** Inter (via Google Fonts) ## 🚦 Getting Started ### Prerequisites - [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/) (v16+ recommended) - A [Cartesia AI](https://cartesia.ai/) API key ### Installation 1. **Clone the repository:** ```bash git clone https://github.com/websmartbd/voxgen.git cd voxgen ``` 2. **Install dependencies:** ```bash npm install ``` 3. **Configure environment:** (Optional for local use) Create a `.env` file in the root if you want to set a default port: ```env PORT=3000 ``` 4. **Start the server:** ```bash node server.js ``` 5. **Open in browser:** Navigate to `http://localhost:3000` ## ⚙️ Usage 1. **API Key:** Open the settings sidebar and enter your Cartesia API Key. 2. **Voice ID:** Enter a valid Cartesia Voice ID (e.g., `1574ed27-2625-47f9-a3a2-b3a8beadf2`). 3. **Speed:** Select your preferred playback speed. 4. **Generate:** Type your script and hit **Generate** or press `Ctrl+Enter`. ## 🛡️ Security & Transparency Trust is paramount when dealing with API tokens. Here is how VoxGen protects your credentials: - **Client-Side Storage:** Your Cartesia API key is stored only in your browser's `localStorage`. It is never written to a database or stored on our servers. - **Local Proxy Pattern:** When you generate audio, the key is sent to the local `/api/tts` endpoint. This endpoint acts as a direct pass-through (proxy) to Cartesia's official API. The server never logs or retains the key. - **Open Source:** By making this project open-source, we invite you to audit the `server.js` and `public/script.js` files to ensure no "home-calling" or data exfiltration is occurring. - **One-Click Clear:** Use the "Clear Credentials" button in the sidebar to instantly wipe all saved data from your browser's storage. ## 🚢 Deployment VoxGen is pre-configured for deployment on **Vercel** or any Node.js hosting platform. ### Deploy to Vercel The project includes an `export default app` in `server.js` for serverless function support. ```bash vercel deploy ``` ## 🤝 Contributing Contributions are what make the open-source community such an amazing place to learn, inspire, and create. # 🕌 Namaz App - সহজ নামাজ শিক্ষা 📖✨

![Namaz App Preview](https://img.shields.io/badge/Status-Active-brightgreen) ![HTML5](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML5-E34F26?style=flat&logo=html5&logoColor=white) ![CSS3](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS3-1572B6?style=flat&logo=css3&logoColor=white) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-F7DF1E?style=flat&logo=javascript&logoColor=black) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind_CSS-38B2AC?style=flat&logo=tailwind-css&logoColor=white)

A beautifully designed, easy-to-use, and fully dynamic web application for learning how to perform Salah (Namaz). This app provides step-by-step guidance for all five daily prayers, including Witr, Tahajjud, and Ishraq, complete with Arabic text, Bengali translation, and pronunciation.

Designed with a modern "glassmorphic" UI, smooth animations, and a mobile-first approach, it aims to make learning Namaz accessible and intuitive for Bengali-speaking users.

---

## 🌟 Features

*   **Complete Prayer Guide:** Detailed, step-by-step instructions for Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha, Witr, Tahajjud, and Ishraq.
*   **Dynamic Rakat Generation:** Automatically generates the correct sequence of steps, Surahs, and Duas based on the selected prayer and its type (Farz, Sunnah, or Nofol).
*   **Rich Surah Library:** Integrates 11 well-known Surahs (Al-Fatiha, Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq, An-Nas, Al-Kawthar, Al-Asr, Al-Ma'un, Al-Fil, Quraish, Al-Kafirun, An-Nasr) that rotate dynamically across different Rakats to enhance variety.
*   **Trilingual Support:** Every Dua and Surah is presented in clear **Arabic** script, accurate **Bengali pronunciation**, and detailed **Bengali meaning**.
*   **Interactive UI:**
    *   Clean, minimalist design utilizing **Tailwind CSS**.
    *   Animated "Sticky Status Bar" when scrolling to keep track of the current Rakat and Prayer type.
    *   Smooth horizontal and vertical navigation free of UI layout shifts (glitches).
    *   Expandable "Meaning/Translation" (অর্থ দেখুন) sections to keep the interface uncluttered.
*   **Responsive & Mobile-First:** Carefully crafted padding and responsive typography ensure edge-to-edge readability on smaller screens while looking professional on desktops.
*   **SEO Optimized:** Fully equipped with meta tags, Open Graph (Facebook), and Twitter Cards for optimal search engine visibility and social media sharing. Offline-ready potential.

---

## 🚀 Live Demo

**[Namaz Guide App - Live Preview](https://namaz-guides.vercel.app/)**

---

## 📂 Project Structure

The project relies entirely on client-side technologies (Vanilla JS, HTML, CSS), meaning no backend server is required to run the core features.

```text
namz/
│
├── index.html        # Main entry point containing the UI structure and SEO tags.
├── css/
│   └── app.css       # The compiled Tailwind stylesheet linked in the HTML.
├── js/
│   ├── app.js        # Core logic for DOM manipulation, navigation (Next/Prev), and smooth scrolling.
│   └── data.js       # Dynamic data structure containing all Prayers, Surahs, Duas, and state logic.
└── img/
    └── favicon.png   # Application icon.
```

---

## 🛠️ Technologies Used

*   **Frontend Framework:** Tailwind CSS v4 (locally compiled for maximum performance and offline support).
*   **Core Logic:** Vanilla JavaScript (ES6+).
*   **Markup & Styling:** HTML5, CSS3.
*   **Typography:** Google Fonts (`Amiri` and `Noto Naskh Arabic` for authentic Arabic rendering; `Hind Siliguri` for beautiful Bengali display).

---

## 💻 Installation & Setup

Since this application's CSS is now fully precompiled locally using Tailwind CSS v4, you can run it offline without needing any extra setup.

1.  **Clone the repository:**
    ```bash
    git clone https://github.com/websmartbd/namaz-guide.git
    cd namaz-guide
    ```

2.  **Run Locally (Ready-to-use):**
    You don't need any build tools to view the app. Just open the `index.html` file in your preferred browser, or use **Live Server** in VS Code.

3.  **Development / Editing CSS:**
    If you wish to modify the Tailwind utility classes or edit the CSS:
    ```bash
    npm install
    ```
    Then, to start the Tailwind watcher while you work:
    ```bash
    npm run dev
    ```
    To create a minified production build:
    ```bash
    npm run build
    ```

---

## 💡 How It Works (Behind the Scenes)

*   **State Management:** The app relies on three main variables in `app.js` (`currentPrayer`, `currentType`, `currentPhase`) to quickly swap out the UI elements without reloading the page.
*   **Data Structure (`data.js`):** The `generateSteps()` function acts as the brain of the app. It constructs arrays of objects detailing every single posture (Qiyam, Ruku, Sujud), the associated Duas, and the necessary Surah distribution logic (e.g., ensuring Witr gets Dua Qunut in the 3rd Rakat).
*   **Scroll Calculations:** To prevent awkward jumps when navigating, the app uses safe math calculations (`offsetLeft`, `clientWidth`) to precisely scroll the horizontal tabs into the center of the viewport via `.scrollTo({ behavior: 'smooth' })`.

---

## 🤝 Contributing

Contributions, issues, and feature requests are welcome! If you spot a typo in the Arabic/Bengali transliteration, or have ideas for new features (e.g., Audio Recitations, Qibla Compass, or Dark Mode), feel free to contribute.

5. Open a Pull Request

Philosopher Quotes is a web application that allows users to explore inspiring quotes from famous philosophers. With a user-friendly interface, users can easily discover wisdom, insight, and thought-provoking ideas on various topics such as life, love, knowledge, and more.

## Features

- Browse a curated collection of quotes from renowned philosophers.
- Select quotes by category to find inspiration on specific topics.
- Powered by the Quotable API, ensuring a diverse and engaging selection of quotes.

## Usage

1. Clone the repository to your local machine:

2. Open the `index.html` file in your web browser.

3. Select a category from the dropdown menu and click "Show Quote" to display a random quote from that category.

4. Explore different categories to discover insightful quotes from famous philosophers.

## Credits

This project is powered by the [Quotable API](https://api.quotable.io/), which provides a rich collection of quotes from various sources.

Weather Report


## 🚀 Features - Saving the weather data in redux-store and session storage to reduce the dependency on network requests - Search weather details according to the city - Detect your current location for displaying weather data - Shows a map of that location - Sync data to get the latest updated details of the current weather - Toast notification for every action - Pop-up modal to display extra details of seven-day forecast weather - Cool zoom-in zoom-out animations - Responsive for every screen size.
## Getting Started This project was built using React v 17.0.2, Redux v 4.1.2, Chakra UI, CSS, and Rest API. It is a web application and for running on your local environment you should follow these guidelines. ### Prerequisites - NPM ### Setup The project repository can be found in [GitHub link](https://github.com/m-sehrawat/Weather-App) or just clone the project using this command. ``` Using HTTPS # git clone https://github.com/m-sehrawat/Weather-App.git ``` + Open the terminal on your workspace with ``` cd /home/workspace/Weather-App ``` ## Install Install NPM Check that you have node and npm installed To check if you have Node.js installed, run this command in your terminal: ``` node -v ``` To confirm that you have npm installed you can run this command in your terminal: ``` npm -v ``` To install all the dependencies of the project, run the following command: ``` npm install ``` To run the application, run the following command: ``` npm run dev ``` ### Tools used on this project - Visual Studio Code - Vite Js React Template
